messages:
ali: Heads-up: opened PR to change default retry policy in ruby-sdk from exponential backoff (base 0.1s) to jittered linear (base 0.2s) to reduce burst retries against our hosted endpoints. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ruby-sdk/pull/4120

tessa: What's the backward-compat story? This will affect existing installs that don't pin versions. Need to call out in changelog and maybe add opt-in env var for older behavior.

marco: Curious about metrics impact. Do we have data that exponential spikes cause more transient 429s?

ali: Short summary of analysis: saw tails of 429s in short-lived CI storms; exponential with small base leads to tight retry loops under connection churn. Switching to linear+jitter spreads retries and empirically lowered 429 client-side incidence in a small canary. I can paste loadbench graphs in the PR.

ci-bot: GitHub Actions: ruby-ci (PR #4120) 

Checks started: unit / integration / lint

ali: Proposed implementation details: add REDWOOD_RETRY_STRATEGY env (values: exponential|linear), default pick 'linear' in 0.10.x branch. Also keep retry middleware pluggable:
```ruby
client = Redwood::Client.new(retry_strategy: ENV.fetch('REDWOOD_RETRY_STRATEGY','linear'))
```

tessa: If we change default in a minor release, we must document and add an entry to upgrade notes. Also please add feature flag gating in the client initializer so infra teams can opt-out quickly.

marco: Leave a short compatibility test verifying behavior when REDWOOD_RETRY_STRATEGY is set to exponential. We should also add a quick integration test to assert we don't hammer backend under failure bursts.

ali: Added tests + changelog draft. Also added a small migration note in UPGRADE.md. One wrinkle: some community downstreams expect exponential for latency-sensitive retries; I put the env override as highest precedence so they can preserve old behavior.

ci-bot: GitHub Actions: ruby-ci (PR #4120) 

Integration failed: flaky test 'test_retry_middleware_handles_429s' on windows-latest. Error: AssertionTimeout at test_helper.rb:56

ali: Reproduced failure on Windows runner locally in CI matrix - looks like sleep timing is less reliable on windows CI and test is too strict. Will refactor to poll with generous timeout instead of exact sleep.

tessa: Good catch. Also, can you add a short paragraph in sampleapp README describing the new env var so onboarding doesn't surprise new users?

ali: Yup will add README blurb + docs note. One more ask: can docs team publish a short note in console docs about retry strategy differences across hosted/dedicated/private? @doc-bot can we do a tiny entry?

doc-bot: notebook: Created draft doc 'Retry strategies and platform behavior' in docs queue. Linking to PR once merged.

marco: LGTM once windows test is fixed. Thanks for addressing the compatibility concerns. :+1:

ci-bot: GitHub Actions: ruby-ci (PR #4120) 

All checks passed on branch 'retry-linear-opt-in' (ubuntu-22.04 / macos-latest / windows-latest).

ali: Pushed windows test fix and changelog + sampleapp README blurb. Requesting merge.

tessa: Approved. Please make sure the release notes mention the env var and default change for the patch release.

ali: Will coordinate with release to ship 0.10.5 and add a short note in the release email for customers. Thanks all.
